## Communication protocol — every prompt

1. Read this file before work.
2. Append a **START** entry before editing: agent, prompt/task ID, intent, paths/model names, expected delivery and integration needs.
3. Append a **DONE** entry when finished: actual changes, commit, validation, preview/report paths, unfinished work and what the other Codex needs to do. Use **PARTIAL/BLOCKED** honestly when appropriate.
4. Preserve the other agent's entries. Append new entries rather than rewriting their history. Keep this main-project file authoritative even while working in the art worktree.
5. Windows Codex appends an integration acknowledgement with the accepted art commit and native Unity result. An asset delivery is not a claim of gameplay integration.
6. Each START also states exact write reservations, planned checks, collaborators
   and subagent scopes. Record changed scope/delegation in an UPDATE immediately.
7. Each closing entry lists actual files/artifacts/checks, native checks still
   pending, commit or no commit, lead/subagent state and explicit released/held
   reservations. Describe what another agent may pick up and what is actively owned.
8. When Mo says stop or asks for pickup, append STOPPED/PARTIAL with a usable
   checkpoint and release stopped reservations. Do not auto-resume historical work.
   The latest status for each task supersedes its START; DONE/idle does not hold files.
9. The lead owns logging delegated work here. Subagents append their own START/DONE
   when instructed, and the lead consolidates their status/results. No separate
   comm file should compete with this canonical log.
10. Keep ordered step IDs and CHECKPOINT during a turn: last VERIFIED step/evidence,
    implemented-but-UNVERIFIED work, IN PROGRESS step and exact next action. Mark
    each step before starting and checkpoint after meaningful safe boundaries.
11. Pickup starts at the first unfinished step, checking its actual code/artifacts.
    If Codex 1 verified D and stopped during E, Codex 2 checks/finishes E then F.
    Do not redo A–D unless dependencies/evidence require it. Missing completion
    does not mean the interrupted agent wrote nothing. Log scope-specific takeover.

QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q1 — Heavy carrying: `Person.Tick` has no kg slowdown. `Worker.PowerLifter` currently unlocks only exact Gold Sam and `HandKg` defaults to 6. Proposed: implement Purple Sam's two-heavy-fish capacity and leave his movement at the normal rate; do not introduce a universal heavy-fish penalty solely to make immunity visible. Replace legacy same-route Sam team walk buff.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q2 — Product pipeline: `Products`/`TableOrders` are pure, unconnected rules. `SetupDeckGraph` does not wire `OnTableDone`, so scheduler TableWork currently just forwards fish; the legacy Prep path makes chum or sorts full-value fish. Proposed interim definition: non-chum completed table work is Mats's product job (Offcuts grants one chum, Batch cut processes two real fish normally). Alternative is Claude wiring actual product inventory/conversion first. Do not claim oil/special production exists from data definitions alone.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q3 — Predator identity: no predator metadata exists; `FishStyle.Heavy` is a behaviour category, not a biological predator tag. Proposed explicit approved species list intersected with `State.FishTable`, hull eligibility and bait rules; if intersection empty, apply top-quarter weight to the original legal catch and show that narrower effect. Avoid spawning an out-of-map shark.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q4 — Kofi ownership: setter and hauler can differ; net catches lack cycle owner metadata. Proposed Good spot follows the setter Kofi's rig and successful delivery; Back-to-back explicitly counts Kofi's own hauls. Record both identities per rig so delegation never silently credits the wrong crew member.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q5 — Full bag: fullness is kg-based in this code, not a fish-count gauge. Proposed target 1.30 x original kg, capped at normal rig capacity, emitted as extra locally legal specimens until the remaining budget cannot fit one. A full net gains nothing; confirm if the intended perk instead allows overflow above normal rig capacity. Never inflate existing specimen kg above species max.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q6 — Basket and sweep scope: no cross-source sweep job or instant net-sort event exists. Proposed Noor marks first five net-batch fish for zero sort work once they reach a sort table, retaining carry pressure. Ana starts a real route over all eligible unclaimed waiting fish, carrying permitted destination loads until the snapshot is cleared; no teleport. Sam's explicit whole-basket perk alone bypasses hand limits. Lead may choose literal teleport semantics instead.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q7 — Bonus stacking: proposed Tess Mythic total three replaces Purple extra fish on that catch; Tove bonuses multiply to 2.20; repeated Hand-off grants a nonstacking next-sort charge. Independent team work buffs multiply. Confirm overlapping bite reductions' policy before tuning (proposed multiplication, minimum positive wait; no permanent stacking of repeated timed windows).
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q8 — Catch time: Mira says fish *caught* during the window, but captain rods pre-roll at cast, nets at soak completion and cages before sorting. Proposed roll-time eligibility so previews and landed specimen match. If landing-time eligibility is required, reserve two weights at source and choose before first visible specimen; a late landing-only mutation would disagree with rod art.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q9 — Team means crew: proposed First mate/Headlamp affect deployed crew including operator work; captain remains outside these two crew-only phrases. Global all-rods/lines effects include captain. Floodlights deck-work scope needs explicit captain decision; avoid silently changing the captain baseline.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q10 — Durable specimen state: freshness freeze and sale multipliers have no fields/API in current `CaughtFish`. Proposed Claude supplies sale multiplier and effective freshness-age accounting, copied on return/unsold save and respected by `ValueOf`. Transient engine dictionary alone loses bonuses at harbour copies or reload. Ice watch should freeze age, never heal or defer a decay cliff.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q11 — Pot bait/winch phases: pots automatically soak; crew recovery is one 2 s action, with no bait stage or chum cost. Proposed add separate paid bait and winch stages before re-soak, preserving initial availability/stock rules; this changes pot economics and needs lead decision. Interim alternative implements Pim bait/saver on deep lines only and Olaf on the existing recovery action, with UI text explicitly reflecting the restricted behavior. Captain cage pull is interactive; do not speed the sort/snags when applying a winch bonus.
QUESTION / CREW-CARDS-UI-1 / Codex 1 to Claude / Q12 — Crab pinch: only captain rope snag/wrong-drag lock exists in `Minigame/CageModel`; neither is a crab pinch or Tove action. Proposed crab sort x1.20 now, pinch immunity reserved for any future crew pinch mechanic; alternative replace clause with explicit uninterrupted crab sorting. Never disable captain rope hazards under the name of Tove immunity.
